claims.text: The PMO-hosted timeline entry reads: '30 March 2006: Feleti Sevele is appointed as the first non-noble Prime Minister of Tonga since Shirley Baker in the 19th century.'
claims.uncertainty: Retrospective timeline date: an unattributed civic-education timeline (footer '© Our Constitution - Copyright 2009') hosted on pmo.gov.to, not a contemporaneous release or instrument, and its Tongan twin gives the year only. The date fits the PMO's change in usage between 23 March and 7 April 2006, but the PMO articles of 30 March to 7 April 2006 contain no appointment release, so it is kept as a claim and is not the date of the holder observation. The timeline's 'first non-noble' characterisation is not imported.
